name: url
label: URL
help: Enter an API path relative to https://api.magichour.ai, such as /v1/account. Include the leading slash and version. Put query parameters in Query string. Full URLs, dot segments, percent escapes, backslashes, fragments and query strings in this field are not accepted.

name: headers
label: Headers
help: You don't have to add authorization headers; we already did that for you. Authorization cannot be overridden.

spec.name: key
spec.label: Name
spec.help: Enter an HTTP header name other than Authorization.

name: body
label: Body
help: Map the JSON collection or array required by the endpoint. If you have JSON text, parse it with the JSON > Parse JSON module first. Authorization is supplied by your connection. A generation request consumes Magic Hour credits.
